stories.title: Richmond unanimously rejects supervised consumption sites
stories.summary: At the meeting, it stopped short of approving a motion by counc. Sheldon Starrett to ban them entirely on both public and private property.

stories.title: B.C. lawsuit seeks millions in missing restaurant tips from fintech company
stories.summary: In February, members of B.C.’s hospitality industry noticed financial technology company XTM had stopped distributing money — some said they were missing thousands of dollars.

stories.title: Saskatoon potash company signs lease for new U.S. terminal, bypassing B.C.
stories.summary: The company -- based in Saskatoon -- says Longview emerged as its preferred site based on factors including location, logistics and capacity.

stories.title: Coroner’s inquest to be held into 2021 death of Campbell River First Nations man
stories.summary: Relatives of Jared Lowndes, a member of the Laksilyu Clan who lived in Campbell River, say he was shot and killed by unnamed Mounties at a local Tim Hortons on July 8, 2021.

stories.title: CBSA seizes 81 kg of cocaine in lettuce truck crossing from U.S. into B.C.
stories.summary: Officers intercepted a commercial truck arriving from the U.S. on Oct. 23 after noting concerns with its paperwork, the agency said in a news release,

stories.title: Researchers on B.C. coast use drones to collect whale snot for genome sequencing
stories.summary: Eadin O’Mahony, lead researcher in the study published in the scientific journal Molecular Ecology Resources this week, said her team spent 2022 and 2023 collecting the samples.

stories.title: B.C. First Nation, Nanaimo Forest Products sign partnership agreement
stories.summary: The agreement involves Nanaimo Forest Products, which operates Harmac Pacific and has been operating in the Nation's territory for more than 75 years.

stories.title: WATCH: Global News Hour at 6 BC: Nov. 17
stories.summary: Watch the online edition of Global News Hour at 6 BC.

stories.title: Filipino BC calls for audit of Lapu Lapu tragedy response compared to Tumbler Ridge
stories.summary: Filipino BC says in its view, the NDP government should have coordinated both an emergency and recovery response across multiple ministries and agencies.

stories.title: ‘Blood-boiling’: Guardian of young victim in B.C. assault video decries violence
stories.summary: RCMP said the investigation remains active, but three youths were arrested. They cannot be identified due to the Youth Criminal Justice Act.
